summary: The PR removes an unnecessary signal handler for ImageField when width_field and height_field are not set, which improves performance. However, it lacks documentation and could benefit from additional tests.

issues.description: The change does not include any documentation updates to explain why the signal handler is removed and under what conditions.
Additional tests should be added to verify that the removal of the signal handler does not affect the behavior of ImageField when width_field and height_field are set.
